title: Kagamine Len — Happy Anniversary! 2024〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey everyone, sorry for the wait!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's now time for my half of me and Rin's anniversary event!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm so glad everyone seems to still be pumped!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. How about all of you watching on stream?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey! You guys are still fired up to go, right?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<You bet!>
<I'm so hyped!>
<Good luck, everyone!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehehe. Thanks for the support!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, let's sing, sing and sing! We can't lose to everyone's energy!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Co.
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Sing along with us, everyone♪
Here we go!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, put your hands in the air! Let's wave together.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
One, two, three!
 One, two, three!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oooh! Looking good, you guys!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: For everyone watching on stream, please feel free to join in!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, it's time for the real deal!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO, Len & KAITO
rows.Line: Start the music!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys! Go rest until the prep for the next song is all done!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: In the meantime, we'll be doing the long-awaited interview!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Let's recap!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: In Rin's half, I asked her a bunch of questions, but this time it'll be reversed.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'll be asking Len the questions you guys sent in for him!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay... I think we definitely have to start with this one!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Question number one!
“How do you feel celebrating another anniversary?”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Without a doubt, super happy!
I mean, so many people have wished me a happy anniversary.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: There's no way I wouldn't be happy! I have people celebrating with me right here, but there's also people joining in through the stream!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I totally get how you feel! It's so hard not to smile when everyone wishes you a happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay, last question!
“Strike us your coolest pose, Len!”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hahaha! Was that even a question?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Well, I thought it would spice things up. Alright, stand in the middle of the stage and show everyone!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You got it!
Hmm, a cool pose, huh?
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, I know the one!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Okay, here I go!
Feast your eyes on this!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hehe. What do you think?
Pretty cool, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm so relieved! I totally wasn't sure how I was gonna do after a sudden request like that...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa! Why is it dark?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That's because...
It's time for a surprise♪
song00010_off_s

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, Len!
Also, great job being the main MC!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope I've been able to help you out in making sure everyone has a great time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We're entering the finale of the show now, so I'll be doing everything I can to help out until the very end!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Len. The pose you did just now was wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You moved so much during the dancing, chants and shout-outs that I wondered if this is what it means to be bursting with energy.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: When you called out to the audience, you even jumped and waved repeatedly so that the people at the back could see you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I also wanted to add to the energy of you and Rin's anniversary, so I went all out. Have an absolutely amazing anniversary, Len!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Len!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I don't know whether you're immune to fatigue or you just keep getting more and more energetic!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I better not get complacent!
I'm gonna hype it up until the very end!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Len!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You and I have been together for a veeery long time, and it's funny how we either butt heads like crazy or are two peas in a pod!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But even when we do disagree with each other, I learn more about you and other ways of thinking, which is actually really fun!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's why I hope we can continue being close just the way we are!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay everyone, let's wish Len a happy anniversary!
Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Len!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Co.
rows.Line: Happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wow!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I knew that I was going to get anniversary messages, but I didn't think I'd get them like that!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm sure you guys spent a lot of time thinking about how to surprise me with your messages.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehehe. It might seem like something small, but it means a lot to me that you'd put in this much thought just for me! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Len!
Let's sprint to the finish!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's make this the best anniversary ever!
